editorial:
Imagine waking up and finding out the police think you robbed a bank, but you are actually just a writer who can't get out of trouble. That is exactly where you start with this funny story. You get to follow a guy who has to turn to his ex-wife for help because she is a great lawyer. The catch is that she is remarried, and her new husband is hosting a big party for the very cops who are hunting him down. The vibe is light and breezy, like a classic sitcom where everything that could go wrong does go wrong in the most awkward ways possible.

You will love the chemistry between the leads and the funny tension of the hide-and-seek game happening in the house. The pacing stays quick, though some of the jokes feel a bit dated since it is an older film. If you enjoy romantic comedies with a bit of a mystery, you should definitely check this out. You can easily rent it on Apple TV for a movie night or add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you love high-quality classics. It is a great pick for a rainy Sunday afternoon.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head at the party where the truth finally comes out. After a lot of hiding and arguing, the lawyer ex-wife manages to prove that her former husband was framed for the crime. The real thief is caught, and the police apologize for the mistake. In the end, the couple realizes they still have feelings for each other, leaving you with a happy and heartwarming conclusion where the legal mess is solved.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school romantic comedies and funny misunderstandings.
